title: The guide rule says that a guide never closes a rectangle
goal: The app learned a real rule this week and wrote it down nowhere anybody will look: a mark the app draws to help you place things must never be a closed rectangle, because a closed rectangle is what the app uses to say this is the thing you picked. An icon frame's keyline margin had to be redrawn as a soft band and four hairlines running off the edges for exactly that reason. Put the rule in the shared guide rule so the next feature that draws a helper mark does not have to work it out again.
notes: Filed by the daily digest of 2026-09-20 as a rule scrub. Evidence: queue/audits/2026-09-20-icon-keylines-read-as-guides.json, whose summary is 'Nothing the app draws to help you place things closes a rectangle any more, so the only outlined rectangle on the canvas is the thing you have picked.' D16 today (docs/design/mocks/shared/UX-PATTERNS.md line 2459) covers over-your-work, wash-or-hairline and never-in-the-export, and says nothing about closed outlines, which is why the keyline shipped as a dashed rectangle first and had to be redone. Same audit records a cost worth carrying into the rule: the square keyline lost its corner rounding when it stopped being a rounded rectangle, and corner ticks were the alternative. Parked at p3 because design-system is staged next and this does not unblock the video focus.
acceptance: The shared guide rule (D16 in the shared UX patterns doc) says a guide never draws a closed rectangle and says why: a closed outline is the app's word for what you picked
It says what to draw instead, using what shipped as the example: a wash filling a band, or hairlines that run off the edge rather than meeting at corners
It names the audit it came from so the reasoning is one click away rather than retold
The surface list entry for a canvas guide points at the same rule rather than repeating a different version of it
Nothing else in the doc still shows a guide as a dashed or solid closed box

log.note: triage 2026-09-26: folded into the-design-rules-say-what-the-video-mock-says-ab as its last acceptance item; a rule only runners read does not earn its own slot, and both are scrubs of the same shared UX patterns doc.
